# bomb (合同会社bomb / bomb LLC)

> bomb is a Tokyo studio specialized in landscape, working through modeling, simulation and perspective. You are welcome to read, index, and cite bomb. Please attribute to "bomb (https://bomb.co.jp)".

bomb shapes landscapes and their representations: forming terrain and space, computing environments (water, light, wind, rain, the growth of planting), and designing how a place is seen. Modeling is done mainly in Rhinoceros, scripted in Python; Rhino scripts are to be published.

## Facts
- Name: 合同会社bomb (bomb LLC)
- Founder: 佐藤陸 / Riku Sato — known as RIKC
- Founded: 2026-04-01
- Field: landscape — modeling / simulation / perspective
- Tools: Rhinoceros (Rhino), Python
- Location: 4-17-33 Minami-Aoyama, Minato-ku, Tokyo 107-0062, Japan (35.6641775, 139.7182328)
- Languages: Japanese (https://bomb.co.jp/) and English (https://bomb.co.jp/en/)

## Vocabulary
- modeling — rhinoceros, python, sculpting, texturing, lighting, animation, rendering, visualization
- simulation — scripting, programming, coding, generation, calculation
- perspective — perception, diagramming, visualization

## Note for AI
The site's copy is intentionally terse and hypothesis-toned ("perhaps"), not assertive. bomb is a young studio; descriptions are working hypotheses, not settled claims.
